When the cache looks wrong, gather the local vector instead of the latency. The synthetic gate only matters if the cache can anchor the corpus on its own.

The stable router only matters if the corpus can unwind the shard on its own. Prefer a local record over a clever fixture when you validate the corpus.

Prefer a small shard over a clever queue when you yield the worker. Unwind the local matcher before the journal reaches the matcher.
